name: Mikado
source:
Appointed by Shibagami, [spoiler]who saved her from death ten years ago, [/spoiler]this girl has the power to eliminate the chaos in the empire of Japan. [spoiler]With a sworn duty to protect Japan, she can use the ability to summon "Holy Wind" to drive away disasters, through she had some psi-abilities even before becoming a Mikado.[/spoiler] As ruler of the country, she has absolute power in the Nation's decision-making. With her cheerfulness, and kindness, and constant principle "a harmony is a greatest virtue", she is friendly to everyone and want everyone to be friendly to each other. But due to her position, she has trouble making close friends. 

[Partially and edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Mikado]AliceSoft Wiki[/url].]

"As long as one people control others, all of them cannot be on the good terms. Therefore, let us unite the world."
